title: WAGR-348 (Done) still says no rep-facing surface shows Partner; 09-23 decided reps see partner short code in header and full name on hover

jira.summary: BUILD-21 — Hide Partner from all Rep-facing views
Sign-Up: Reorganize header — Proof/Completion right, Partner short code, Deal Info section
jira.quote: Add Partner to the header, displayed as the short code (not the full partner name), e.g. "GDC" not the full name.

transcript_evidence.quote: Lina Ceniccola: Because now seeing this I'm wondering if in the header can we just at least add the partner. So operator partner / Kobi Kunasekaran: within these. Yeah, we can add the partner field here. / Lina Ceniccola: Originally I said no like not surfacing all that Gil information but if we can add in just that partner piece then we're good / Kobi Kunasekaran: we could uh we could display the partner short code instead of the full one.
Lina Ceniccola: I think we said to start we can keep all info. / Emily Vandenberg: Okay, you're good with that. / Lina Ceniccola: Yeah.

what_differs: WAGR-348 sets an absolute rule that no rep-facing surface exposes Partner. On 09-23 the client decided reps see the partner short code in the sign-up header and keep the full partner name on deal hover (built as WAGR-422).
suggested_action: Add a comment on WAGR-348 that the 09-23 decision partly supersedes its AC, and link it to WAGR-422 so UAT scripts do not test the old rule.
